# Automatic-change help compares the submitted snapshot and preserves error descriptions

The controller copies the filled submitted configuration before guessing, then passes it to the actual form's setState options. The form compares ten control values, maps select values to option labels and supplies old/new help arguments only for changed values. Input errors and select warnings retain accessible-description priority; clearing transient input help can restore static help. The isolated tests assert metadata, description links and input-triggered clearing, not controller/network success or a native accessibility result. The accepted manual test checks transient-class removal rather than hidden input help, reflecting the static-help boundary.

Scope: Account Hub manual-test snapshot, widget help and accessible description.
